name: pdfik
description: Turn URL/HTML/Markdown into PDFs, screenshots and Factur-X e-invoices with PDFik.
long_description: Ask your assistant to turn a web page, HTML or Markdown into a PDF or a screenshot, or to build a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoice from invoice XML. Files are saved in a folder on your computer; the assistant gets the path. Needs a PDFik API key (every plan, Free included).

tools.name: url_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a public web page to PDF

tools.name: url_to_image
tools.description: Capture a web page as PNG/JPEG

tools.name: einvoice_to_pdf
tools.description: Build a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoice PDF from CII XML

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the status of a job

tools.name: download_job
tools.description: Save the output of a finished job

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Plan, quota window, usage and limits of the API key
